gates.title: Random play holds its own
gates.caption: the engine with 1,000 playouts per move fails to beat a random mover 90% of the time: the rules leave nothing to think about

gates.title: Thinking harder doesn't help
gates.caption: ten times the search budget wins fewer than 70% of games: the outcome is mostly luck

gates.title: Too many draws
gates.caption: more than one game in five ends without a winner

gates.title: Lopsided
gates.caption: one colour wins more than three games in four

gates.title: Over too fast, or never over
gates.caption: average game fills less than a quarter of the board, or more than three quarters

gates.title: Foregone conclusions
gates.caption: in more than a third of games the winner is already at 90% before the game is 60% done
